اكتسحوا (form VIII)
# اِكْتَسَحُوا (iktasaḥū) /ik.ta.sa.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
# اُكْتُسِحُوا (uktusiḥū) /uk.tu.si.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
# اِكْتَسِحُوا (iktasiḥū) /ik.ta.si.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
